prompt: Implement the two exported functions in cart-progress.js for a Shopify cart drawer widget (plain Node-compatible CommonJS, no deps). freeShippingState(subtotalCents, thresholdCents) -> {unlocked, percent, remainingCents}: percent is an integer 0-100 (floor, capped at 100), unlocked when subtotal >= threshold, remainingCents never negative; if thresholdCents <= 0 or not a finite number treat the offer as disabled and return {unlocked:false, percent:0, remainingCents:0, disabled:true}, otherwise disabled:false. formatMoney(cents, symbol) -> string like "₹1,234.50": thousands separated with commas, always 2 decimals, negative renders as "-₹0.70", non-finite input renders symbol+"0.00". Run: node test.js
